 The Home Depot Kicks Off Black Friday Season With Unbeatable Value Across Tools, Home Upgrades, and Holiday Decor
 October 29, 2026 
 The Home Depot is kicking off the holiday season with deals made for the doers. From November 5 through 25, customers can shop the Black Friday Savings Event in store and online for savings on holiday décor, power tools, major appliances and more home improvement essentials.
 Whether they’re getting their homes ready for holiday gatherings, finding the right gift or tackling a long-awaited home upgrade, shoppers can discover seasonal must-haves and trusted favorites at their local Home Depot. No matter what customers are shopping for, they can receive all their holiday essentials in time for the festivities with convenient express delivery options.
 “Black Friday is an amazing opportunity for customers to find great value on all they need for the holiday season,” said Rodes Bazzel, senior vice president of merchandising at The Home Depot. “Customers can find the perfect gift for the doer on their list, deck the halls with our show-stopping holiday decor, and tackle winter projects.”
 The Home Depot Black Friday Savings Event Includes:
 Find the Perfect Gift for the Doers on Your List: Whether customers need to treat themselves or find a gift for DIYers in their life, The Home Depot has holiday deals on power tools, smart home products and other gifts to tackle any project on the to do list. A standout offer: select power tool BOGOs, where shoppers who purchase a participating tool or battery kit from brands including RYOBI, Milwaukee and DEWALT, can receive a free select power tool. Shoppers can also save on Hubspace smart home products, tool kits, accessories and other jaw-dropping gifts in store and online at The Home Depot.
 Deck the Halls for Less: Bring holiday celebrations to life with savings on indoor and outdoor decorations. Customers can find festive favorites, including 6.5-foot LED pre-lit artificial Christmas trees for $49.98, select 3.5-foot LED pre-lit inflatables for $19.98 and 100-count LED string lights as low as $5.98. Shoppers can also explore oversized decorations, ornaments, lights and other seasonal essentials to create a festive display inside and outside the home.
 Upgrade the Home for the Holidays: The holidays mean hosting and it’s a great time to upgrade major appliances like refrigerators, freezers, washers, dryers, dishwashers and cooking appliances before the guests arrive. Customers can save up to an extra $500 on qualifying refrigeration purchases of $2,498 or more, up to $300 on laundry purchases of $1,698 or more, up to $300 on cooking purchases of $1,498 or more and up to $150 on dishwasher purchases of $798 or more, with a maximum discount of $1,250.
 Customers can explore additional Black Friday deals throughout the ad, including select online offers. Product selection, pricing and promotions may vary between stores and online.
 To shop The Home Depot's Black Friday deals, visit homedepot.com or download The Home Depot app. Offers, prices and availability may vary. See store and online for details.
